description: Final documentation: comprehensive README.md, architecture decision records, and changelog covering all 21+1 stages of development
steps: Create README.md at project root with: project name (Propela Ops), description (nurse recruitment and placement management platform), feature list covering all modules (Dashboard, Nurse Database, Acquisition Hub, Cohort Manager, Outreach Log, Placement Tracker, Analytics, Document Management, Communications, Reports, Integrations, Audit Trail, Search & Navigation, Workflow Automation, Notifications, Help & Onboarding, Mobile/PWA, Performance, Deployment, Settings, Status Page), tech stack section, getting started instructions (prerequisites: Node.js 22+, npm install --legacy-peer-deps, npm run dev, npm run build, npm run test), project structure overview, and contributing guidelines.

Create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with architecture decision records: (1) React SPA with client-side routing - chosen for simplicity and offline capability, (2) localStorage for persistence - no backend needed for MVP, enables offline-first, (3) Tailwind CSS v4 - utility-first for rapid UI development, (4) Vite for build tooling - fast HMR and optimized builds, (5) AppContext for global state - simpler than Redux for this scale, (6) Code splitting with lazy loading - performance optimization for 17+ pages, (7) i18next for internationalization - future multi-language support.

Create docs/CHANGELOG.md summarizing all 22 stages: Stage 1 - Project Setup & Dashboard, Stage 2 - Nurse Database & Pipeline, Stage 3 - Acquisition Hub, Stage 4 - Cohort Manager, Stage 5 - Outreach Log, Stage 6 - Placement Tracker, Stage 7 - Analytics, Stage 8 - Document Management, Stage 9 - Communications, Stage 10 - Reports & Export, Stage 11 - Integrations & API, Stage 12 - Audit Trail, Stage 13 - Search & Navigation, Stage 14 - Workflow Automation, Stage 15 - Notifications & Alerts, Stage 16 - Help & Onboarding, Stage 17 - Mobile & PWA, Stage 18 - Performance Optimization, Stage 19 - Further Performance, Stage 20 - Accessibility & i18n, Stage 21 - Deployment & Production, Stage 22 - Final Polish & Integration Testing.

Create docs/COMPONENTS.md documenting key reusable components with their props: EmptyState (icon, title, description, actionLabel, onAction), PageTransition (children, className), LoadingSpinner (no props), VirtualList (items, renderItem, itemHeight, className), ResponsiveTable (columns, data, onRowClick), ResponsiveModal (isOpen, onClose, title, children, size), CollapsibleFilter (title, children, defaultOpen), ErrorBoundary (children, fallback).
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists at project root with project overview, features list, tech stack, getting started, and project structure
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md exists with at least 5 architecture decision records
docs/CHANGELOG.md exists with entries for all 22 stages
docs/COMPONENTS.md exists documenting at least 6 key components with props
Build still passes after adding documentation files
verification: Run: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build
Run: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
findings: All four documentation files created successfully. Build and all 262 tests pass. README.md at root, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with 10 ADRs, docs/CHANGELOG.md with 22 stages, docs/COMPONENTS.md with 8 components documented.
